content.short: Catizen is a Telegram GameFi app built around a cat-themed mini-game universe, rewards, and on-chain activity.
content.description: Catizen is a Telegram-native GameFi project with a cat cafe-style mini-game and a wider Meow Universe around play, rewards, and on-chain users. Its site describes mini-games, AI and metaverse themes, player activity, and community scale. It fits the TON game category because the main product is a Telegram game experience, not a standalone exchange or wallet. Dive into the Meow Universe, where each heartbeat echoes with the promise of uncharted territories!. Those details make onchain txs, onchain users, total catizens, and a cat café-themed mini-game adventure part of the product story.
